results.title: Aoife Ní Fhearraigh
results.text: Aoife Ní Fhearraigh, or simply Aoife (] ) is an Irish singer. A well-known interpreter of Irish Gaelic songs, she released her first recording in 1991 and worked with Moya Brennan to produce her much acclaimed 1996 album "Aoife". She reached international recognition in 1998 when her song "The Best is Yet to Come" was used for the "Metal Gear Solid" soundtrack. To date, Aoife has worked closely with artists such as Phil Coulter, Roma Downey and Brian Kennedy, and she has also toured the US, Japan and Europe.

results.title: International Superstar Soccer
results.text: International Superstar Soccer (known as Jikkyō World Soccer in Japan) was the name of a series of football video games developed by Japanese company Konami, mostly by their Osaka branch, Konami Computer Entertainment Osaka (KCEO). Titles in the series appeared on Super NES, Mega Drive, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, PlayStation 2, Xbox, Nintendo GameCube and PC formats. "International Superstar Soccer" should not be confused with Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo's "Pro Evolution Soccer" series (also known as "Winning Eleven"), which was originally developed for the PlayStation.

results.text: Shaman King: Master of Spirits is Metroidvania style platform-adventure video game developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Japan and published by Konami.
